hotels.name: Africa Junction Resort
hotels.description: Boutique resort tucked among acacia trees with traditional Oromo-tufted bungalows, an outdoor pool, and farm-to-table restaurant.

hotels.name: Babogaya Lake View Resort
hotels.description: Clifftop resort overlooking the volcanic crater Lake Babiogaya. Panoramic lake views, terrace dining, and a tranquil garden setting minutes from the city center.

hotels.name: Bekele Molla Hotel
hotels.description: Long-established budget hotel in central Bishoftu, popular with transit travelers and tour groups.

hotels.name: Bishoftu Resort Lodge
hotels.description: Established family-friendly resort with lush gardens, hot-spring-fed pools, and a spa. Walking distance to Lake Hora and the Irecha festival grounds.

hotels.name: Crater View Motel
hotels.description: Convenient roadside motel catering to weekend visitors, with simple rooms and a small café.

hotels.name: Getfam Hotel Bishoftu
hotels.description: Central business hotel with conference facilities, ideal for corporate travelers visiting Bishoftu industrial parks.

hotels.name: Kuriftu Resort & Spa Bishoftu
hotels.description: Premier lakeside resort on the shore of Lake Kuriftu with private beach, infinity pool, spa, and water sports. A flagship destination for lakeside luxury in the Rift Valley.

hotels.name: Lake Hora Lodge
hotels.description: Rustic eco-lodge perched above Lake Hora with wood cabins, traditional Oromo cuisine, and guided crater hikes.

hotels.name: Splash Hotel & Lodge
hotels.description: Affordable lodge near Lake Hora with cozy rooms, breakfast terrace, and tour desk for crater-lake excursions.

hotels.name: The Lake Resort Bishoftu
hotels.description: Modern lakefront resort with private pier, kayak rentals, and rooftop restaurant serving fresh Rift Valley cuisine.

attractions.name: Bishoftu Crater Rim Trail
attractions.description: Hiking trail circling the main crater lakes — a half-day trek offering dramatic cliffside panoramas of the Rift Valley lakes.

attractions.name: Cheleleka Wetland
attractions.description: Seasonal wetland and important bird area — a Ramsar-recognized habitat hosting flamingos, pelicans, and migratory waterfowl.

attractions.name: Ethiopian Air Force Museum
attractions.description: Outdoor and indoor display of historic aircraft, engines, and aviation artifacts chronicling Ethiopia’s air force heritage, headquartered in Bishoftu.

attractions.name: Lake Babiogaya
attractions.description: Twin-crater lake popular for bird-watching and lakeside relaxation, with resorts perched on the crater rim.

attractions.name: Lake Bishoftu
attractions.description: The deepest crater lake in the Bishoftu chain — a sacred, deep-green caldera surrounded by sheer volcanic cliffs. Popular for photography and quiet contemplation.

attractions.name: Lake Hora
attractions.description: Site of the annual Irecha thanksgiving festival — the Oromo people’s most important cultural celebration, held each September on the lake’s grassy shore.

attractions.name: Lake Kuriftu
attractions.description: Recreational lake with beach clubs, kayaking, and the famous Kuriftu Resort & Spa. Best for families and water-sports enthusiasts.

attractions.name: Sodre Hot Springs
attractions.description: Natural geothermal springs on the outskirts of Bishoftu, valued for relaxation and traditional wellness rituals.

attractions.name: St. Gabriel Church
attractions.description: Historic Ethiopian Orthodox church in the heart of Bishoftu, known for its distinctive architecture and annual Timkat procession.

news.title: Irecha Festival 2026 — Lake Hora
news.excerpt: Bishoftu prepares to welcome over 100,000 visitors for this year’s Irecha thanksgiving celebration on the shores of Lake Hora.

news.title: New Spa Wing Now Open
news.excerpt: Kuriftu Resort & Spa unveils a new lakeside spa wing featuring Rift Valley botanical treatments.

news.title: Cheleleka Wetland Bird Count
news.excerpt: Annual bird-monitoring survey recorded 142 species this season — a record for the wetland.

news.title: Family Lakeside Getaway Package
news.excerpt: Bishoftu Resort Lodge launches an all-inclusive weekend package for families visiting the crater lakes.
